notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.content: [h1]Welcome to update 1.1![/h1][p]update 1.1 is mostly small level tweaks and polish chances along with the big new thing:[/p][h3]HARD MODE![/h3][p][/p][p]Hard mode is a remixed way to play Fungi Crossing after you've already finished the main story.[/p][p]In hard mode all levels have modified gravity which can make the platforming harder, alter the solution, or both.[/p][p]The fungi also look different.[/p][p]Hard mode does [i]not[/i] effect cutscenes or any of the story.[/p][p]It's basically a new-game+[/p][p][/p][p]Other than that 1.1 mostly balances and fixes issues with the game[/p][p][/p][h3]NEW THINGS![/h3][olist][*][p]Hard mode[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu hints[/p][/*][*][p]Photos make a noise when used and grow when hovered[/p][/*][*][p]New fungi skin on the level limbo[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3]BUG FIXES![/h3][olist][*][p]Fungi can no longer release each other when un-grounded[/p][/*][*][p]Fungi no longer sometimes fail to stick to a ceiling[/p][/*][*][p]Carriable object progress bar is now readable in all zoom levels[/p][/*][*][p]Inputs read one frame faster[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3]LEVEL TWEAKS![/h3][olist][*][p]Crawlspace ceiling was raised[/p][/*][*][p]Gravity disabled on limbo[/p][/*][*][p]Trash compactor fuel tank made lighter and added arrows[/p][/*][*][p]Hitboxes fixed in botanoaichmoclaustrophobia[/p][/*][/olist]
